rules.title: Schema as contract
rules.text: Treat the schema as the contract: change it additively and deprecate before removing.

rules.title: Batch with dataloaders
rules.text: Batch and cache field resolution with dataloaders to avoid N+1 queries.

rules.title: Query depth and cost limits
rules.text: Enforce query depth, complexity and pagination limits.

rules.title: Intentional nullability
rules.text: Make fields non-null only when failure should fail the parent.

rules.title: Generate types
rules.text: Generate client types and hooks from the schema; do not hand-write them.

rules.title: Authorize in resolvers
rules.text: Authorize in the data layer or resolvers, not only at the gateway.
